trigger: The level-4, 20 mm background meshes failed the unchanged checkMesh skewness gate for both ring-tail variants; the 15 mm clipped-delta control also failed on one highly skew face.
objective: Test whether one matched increase in surface refinement makes the clipped-delta control and its 5 mm and 10 mm ring tails meshable without relaxing any quality gate.

claim_boundary.allowed_claim: Exploratory matched comparison if all three cases pass the existing mesh and run gates.
prohibited_claims: Treating a mesh failure as an aerodynamic loss
Relaxing checkMesh thresholds after seeing results
Comparing remediated rings against an unmatched level-4 control

execution_rule: Generate fresh cases, run mesh-only first, and run the solver only for cases passing the unchanged checkMesh gate.
interpretation_rule: If every case passes, compare last-100 mean Cd within this matched branch. Otherwise report failed variants as unrankable, not aerodynamic losers.
